synchronized_cohort_scenario.classification: primary finite-grid ideal schedule illustration under an explicit synchronized-cohort assumption; not an exact model of unsynchronized CTA staggering
synchronized_cohort_scenario.schedule_policy: balanced CTA-to-SM assignment; on each SM, drain synchronized cohorts of up to 8 CTAs before the next cohort; each cohort shares the SM-wide rates; add source-ordered per-phase costs; finally bound by the whole-GPU HBM floor
synchronized_cohort_scenario.cycle_rounding: ceil each resource substep to integer cycles before source-order summation; max only for explicitly independent work in a phase
synchronized_cohort_scenario.formula_C_batch: sum the source-ordered stages below; Wkk is 8 * (per-pass SMEM service + per-pass HMMA service)
synchronized_cohort_scenario.producer_policy: K and beta are independent source producer branches but their combined whole-packet HBM bytes are charged once against B_share, then their combined SMEM staging bytes once against B_smem; do not stream-overlap those two packet stages in the primary scenario
